title: GET /api/users/me — get current user profile
description: Return the authenticated user's profile data. Never return password_hash, encrypted tokens, or AI API keys.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns: { id, email, name, avatarUrl, aiProvider, hasAiKey (bool), emailNotificationsEnabled, githubConnected (bool), createdAt }
Does NOT return password_hash or encrypted tokens

steps.details: Create server/src/routes/users.ts. GET /me: 1) Find user by req.userId WHERE deleted_at IS NULL. 2) If not found, return 404. 3) Return sanitized user: { id, email, name, avatarUrl, aiProvider, hasAiKey: !!user.aiApiKey, emailNotificationsEnabled, githubConnected: !!user.githubAccessToken, createdAt }.
GET /api/users/me with valid token — verify response has correct fields, NO password_hash.
